messages:
morgan: FYI from support: a customer got billed incorrectly because billing_key was only added during enrichment hours after cost job ran. We need a lightweight approach to surface late attribution keys.

lin: Reingesting full traces on enrich is too heavy. Fanouts will kill cost and throughput.

alejandro: Agreed. Proposal: emit compact 'delta' messages when enrich mutates critical attrs. Payload is trace_id + diffs + seq + provenance. Minimal.

anita: Key constraints: idempotency, ordering, and dedupe. Each delta should carry seq and delta_id. Consumers ignore seq <= stored_seq.

sara: Operationally we should support two modes: nearline (seconds->minutes) using a short-lived delta-store and subscriber joins, and reconciliation for backfills (hours->days) that upserts into billing aggregates. Tier the reconciliation to enterprise/dedicated customers.

morgan: Schema sketch: {trace_id, deltas:{billing_key,tenant_id}, source, seq, origin_ts, delta_id, pipeline_id} - as a single JSON string in the document. Keep deltas tiny.

tim: Delta-store requirements: SSD-backed KV, TTL defaults (1h hosted, 7d enterprise), fast lookups and eviction, metrics for store-size and join-rate, autoscale subscriber to keep join latency <200ms. Handle burst backfills with backpressure policies.

lin: Canonicalization: multiple enrichers may emit conflicting billing_key. Deterministic resolver: canonical service > pipeline precedence > highest seq. Add provenance fields so we can audit decisions.

anita: Dedupe & idempotency: store highest seq per trace_id and ignore older seq; delta_id for cross-retry dedupe; reconciliation uses idempotent upserts and emits audit rows.

sara: UI changes: mark records as 'delta_derived' and show confidence score + provenance. Product must disclose tiered accuracy guarantees in billing docs.

morgan: Edge cases: delta arrives but trace never existed -> create delta_only record and mark low-confidence. Later reconciliation can stitch with logs/traces.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: obs-delta-prototype -> staging @ 03:00 UTC

morgan: Owners/action items:
- RFC for delta-envelope, idempotency, canonicalization (owner: anita)
- Delta-store sizing, TTLs, autoscale (owner: tim)
- Cost-aggregator subscribe + tiered config (owner: lin)
- Reconciliation job upsert semantics (owner: alejandro)
- Billing docs + UI flags (owner: sara)

anita: I'll start the RFC and include sample payloads and a testing checklist: out-of-order deltas, duplicates, late/backfill bursts, delta-only entries.

morgan: Short-term mitigation: add alert when enrich writes billing_key but no billing record within N minutes.

lin: Sync Wed 10:30 for 30m walkthrough. Ping me to join. :calendar:
